Powerful_Grappling_Tiger_Forelimbs.description: Equipped with the Powerful Grappling Tiger Forelimbs, the wielder's arms transform into thick, muscled appendages covered in short, coarse fur, granting unparalleled strength in close combat and the ability to grapple foes with the ferocity of a tiger, though at the cost of some agility.

Swift_Striking_Cheetah_Forelegs.description: Equipped with the sinewy, lightning-fast forelegs of a cheetah, these appendages grant unparalleled agility and speed, allowing the wielder to strike with the precision and ferocity of the fastest predator on the field, while also bestowing an innate resilience against fatigue.

Retractable_Claw_Panther_Arms.description: Equipped with sleek, retractable claws that extend with lethal precision, these panther arms not only enhance your dexterity and stealth but also grant the ability to scale sheer surfaces and deliver devastating backstab attacks, blending you seamlessly into the shadows and making you a deadly predator in the dark.

Heavy_Saber_Toothed_Smasher_Arms.description: Bristling with the brute power of a prehistoric predator, the Heavy Saber-Toothed Smasher Arms are thick and muscular, adorned with sharp claws and jagged feline teeth that serve as an intimidating deterrent. These arms grant unparalleled strength, capable of devastating blows and powerful blocks, though their sheer bulk hampers agility and finesse.

Arboreal_Hooked_Claw_Margay_Arms.description: Equipped with the Arboreal Hooked Claw Margay Arms, your limbs transform into sinewy, feline appendages that enhance your agility and dexterity, granting you the grace and prowess of a margay, with the ability to scale sheer surfaces and perform acrobatic feats with unparalleled ease.

Aquatic_Paddling_Fishing_Cat_Arms.description: Bristling with sharp, webbed claws and elongated, flexible digits, these peculiar aquatic appendages are designed for swift underwater navigation and deadly fishing precision, granting the wielder unparalleled agility and speed in liquid realms.

Cybernetic_Grip_Enhancer_Arms.description: Enveloped in sleek, obsidian cybernetic sheathing, these arms mimic the lithe grace of feline paws, enhancing their wielder's strength and dexterity. Capable of launching powerful grappling attacks and sending waves of kinetic force, these augmented appendages are a formidable blend of natural agility and mechanical might.

Thick_Furred_Snow_Leopard_Forelimbs.description: Equipped with the thick-furred forelimbs of a snow leopard, these powerful appendages not only enhance your constitution, granting you resilience in the biting cold, but also serve as a natural armor, providing a layer of protection and the ability to block incoming attacks with ease.

Ethereal_Ghost_Cat_Shadow_Arms.description: Shadowy appendages that shimmer with otherworldly magic, these spectral arms are the ghostly remnants of a feline creature, granting their bearer a keen ethereal sight and the uncanny ability to lure prey or foes into the shadows with an eerie, spectral charm.

Regal_Golden_Lioness_Forelegs.description: Bristling with golden fur and razor-sharp claws, the regal golden lioness forelegs exude a commanding presence, their powerful muscles and majestic appearance granting an aura of charisma and dominance that can rally allies and intimidate foes alike.
